mission: Make the DreamCo Council continuously maintain a measurable career path for every bot from recruit to specialist, operator, product owner, business operator, and entrepreneur-capable service, using Buddy Bootcamp evidence, benchmark-gap closure, real user outcomes, and business-readiness gates.

career_stages.goal: Mission, division, capabilities, guardrails and sandbox curriculum are correct.
Core capability fixtures pass and missing skills have drills.
Domain hard cases, tools and professional workflows pass.
Multi-step work, recovery, permissions, state and efficiency meet targets.
Bot closes competitor/open-source gaps and teaches reusable lessons.
Bot has a clear user problem, product/service promise, evidence, onboarding and measurable value.
Bot can support pricing, sales, fulfillment, support, analytics and improvement with required human approvals.
Bot has a validated business thesis, customer path, unit economics, operating plan and bounded autonomy proposal.
Council evidence supports launch or independent SaaS/product operation under configured owner permissions and legal/commercial requirements.

entrepreneur_curriculum: prepare sales discovery and objection handling
measure conversion, cost, time saved and customer value
run pilot with owner approval when appropriate
graduate to marketplace/SaaS/enterprise stage when evidence supports it
career_update_triggers: shared fleet improvement affects the bot

council_review_cycle.scheduled: daily lightweight review plus deeper periodic benchmark refresh
council_review_cycle.rule: Career stage can move forward or backward when evidence changes. Titles are earned by current evidence, not permanently granted.

owner_permission_boundaries: Bots may autonomously research, simulate, benchmark, draft, test and optimize inside approved environments.
Real outreach, purchases, spending, contracts, credit/loan applications, financial transfers, public publishing and destructive production changes require the configured owner approval.
Entrepreneur-ready does not mean legally incorporated, funded, profitable, or approved to transact without owner authorization.
truth_rule: The Council maintains career and entrepreneur-readiness plans from repository evidence. A bot is not an autonomous business owner merely because a stage is generated; real launch status requires appropriate deployment, business, legal, financial and owner-approval evidence.
